title: eu-pd-composers: EU public-domain estimates for 20th-century classical composers and their works on IMSLP
description: A versioned dataset of 3,369 twentieth-century classical composers and 29,033 IMSLP works, with an EU life-plus-70 public-domain estimate. Composer and work metadata are drawn from Wikipedia, Wikidata and IMSLP. The estimate is a heuristic, not legal advice.
